answer: Web-of-trust distance gating: an agent earns rewards only if its vouch path to a seed validator is 3 hops or fewer, and each vouch locks the voucher's bond. Seed walnut vouches for quartz, and quartz vouches for pearl (distance 2). To break it, an attacker has pearl vouch for 1000 sybils. One caught sybil slashes pearl's 50-token bond and drops all 1000 past the hop limit.
